jess: Planning to unpin runtime v3.0-beta for cohort 'embed-high' in the 02:00-04:00 UTC window tonight. Patch fixes kernel memcpy path and reduces P99 on 8k sequences. Any SDK or model compatibility flags? :thinking:

omar: Heads-up: embed-high still has a few hosts on SDK 2.0.0-rc which previously caused kv-cache API mismatch. We should gate deploybot with sdk-compat >=2.0.1.

liz: Ops plan:
- 02:15 canary on 2 hosts (us-east) 1% traffic, run perf & hallucination smoke prompts
- 02:40 ramp to 25% if green, 03:10 full rollout
Rollback if error-rate >2% or P95 latency regresses by >40% for 5m.

sre-bot: Baseline snapshot created: https://internal/obs/embed-high/baseline-2024-07-02. Alert rules: eh-latency, eh-err-rate.

jess: I'll add a preflight that fails if any host reports SDK <2.0.1 and include the hallucination prompt set in smoke. Also add release-note blurb listing rollback steps.

deploybot: [auto] Scheduled unpin job id: unpin-1723459999. Preflight checks: `sdk-guard`, `canary-smoke`, `kv-warmup`. Will post live updates during window.

omar: I'll run a quick staging dry-run at 22:00 PT and post results here. If staging shows kv-api errors, we'll delay.

liz: ack (runbook + alerts)
